messages:
Aisha: Quick one 8:30am visitors (2 people) swinging by for a demo. Do we need to preregister or can they just check in?
FrontDesk: Pre-reg is easier but same-day check-ins are fine. If you email names + company to reception@redwood.com well print badges.
Aisha: Sending names now. Also one guest wants to drop a small kit earlier in the day  any special shipping label?
People Ops: Please label: "Redwood Inference - Front Desk
Attn: Aisha (Demo visitors)
[Office street address]". If the box is > 20lb route to Receiving and include tracking in your email.
Devx: Heads-up if they need a visitor laptop or SSO access for a short demo, send their email addresses. We can add a 48h Okta guest.
Nick: Can we reserve two seats in the west bench near whiteboard? The desk app won't let me block for guests.
People Ops: Well reserve two hot desks in West Bench and add an AV note. Confirmed once you send names.
Aisha: Done  names + tracking email sent. Thanks! :party_parrot:
PackageBot: package_registered: 1 parcel expected 2024-05-03 09:15, carrier: DHL, weight: 6lb, tagged: FRONT DESK - Aisha.
FrontDesk: Noted  badges will be at the desk on arrival, buzzer "Main A". If courier arrives early leave at reception and well move to secure storage.
